show_indicator.description: Whether to display the network indicator icon in the system menu.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of saved network connections shown in the indicator menu before truncating.

auto_connect.description: Automatically connect to remembered Wi-Fi or Ethernet networks on startup.

reconnect_delay.description: Number of seconds to wait before retrying a failed network connection attempt.

wired_icon.description: Path to the icon used for active wired (Ethernet) connections.

wireless_icon.description: Path to the icon used for active wireless (Wi-Fi) connections.

disconnected_icon.description: Path to the icon used when no network is connected.

offline_icon.description: Path to the icon used in offline mode.

enable_notifications.description: Show desktop notifications for network connection events (e.g., connected, disconnected).

notify_on.description: List of network types to generate notifications for.

anonymize_ssids.description: Replace actual Wi-Fi SSIDs with generic names (e.g., 'Network 1') in logs and UI for privacy.

suppress_location_hints.description: Hide proximity-based hints (e.g., list of nearby networks) to avoid revealing location.

enable_mobile.description: Enable mobile (cellular) network controls and indicators in the system menu.

apn_overrides.description: List of custom APN configurations for specific mobile providers.

user.description: Username for APN authentication (leave empty if none required).

password.description: Password for APN authentication (leave empty if none required).
